notes: Short Pexels URLs now work. Pasting a Pexels link with just the numeric id (e.g. https://www.pexels.com/video/19232967/) was wrongly rejected as invalid — the validator insisted on the longer 'slug-number' form (e.g. .../dartboard-close-up-34071374/). Both forms are valid Pexels URLs, and both are now accepted, for videos and photos. Fixed in the editor and on the server.
